name: Poterjannaja beskonechnost'
source:
The world of dystopia: what is it like, and why did it become this way? It doesn’t matter much. What matters is who we remain within it: biological machines or humans. Here, there is no place for family, morality, or compassion. There is only the goal. A grand goal. But are we sure we know what we’re striving for? Do we even need it? And when will we catch even a glimpse of this all-consuming infinity?

The main character, Faith, wakes up in the evening in their apartment. An unknown desire pulls them outside today. There, they find the corpse of a beautiful girl. They had often come across dead bodies in this city before, but for some reason, today it felt wrong. Today, nothing will change. Today, nothing is certain. Today...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2583530/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
反乌托邦的世界：它是什么样的，为什么会变成这样？没关系。重要的是我们留在其中的是谁：生物机器还是人类。在这里，没有家庭、道德或同情心。只有目标。一个宏伟的目标。但我们确定我们知道自己在努力争取什么吗？我们还需要它吗？我们什么时候才能瞥见这种吞噬一切的无限呢？

主角费斯晚上在他们的公寓里醒来。今天，一种未知的欲望将他们拉到了外面。在那里，他们发现了一具美丽女孩的尸体。以前他们在这座城市里经常会遇到尸体，但不知道为什么，今天却感觉不对劲。今天，一切都不会改变。今天，没有什么是确定的。今天…

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2583530/]Steam[/url]]
